reviews.title: APP SUPPORT IS NOT RESPONSIVE
reviews.text: I bought standalone version several years ago. It is not transferring to my new phone. NO HELP from my multiple emails to APP SUPPORT. I love the app but very disappointed with App Support.

reviews.title: Started charging money for this app
reviews.text: This is a great app, but they should ask for donations instead of charging. This will keep a lot of people from not being able to read this.

reviews.title: Why do I have to subscribe when I already paid for this!!
reviews.text: Okay what’s up with having to subscribe to get all the devotional when I literally paid for all of them already! This is not okay. This just shows Christian’s only want to make money and if it was really Jesus it wouldn’t be like this.

reviews.title: App glitches
reviews.text: When getting a new phone it makes it impossible to regain your purchase.  This has been an issue for years and happens every time I get a new phone and customer service does not respond w resolutions requiring customers to either pay again or give up.

reviews.title: Excellent Book, Horrible App
reviews.text: I bought “lifetime” access to Jesus Calling many years ago. Now, I get kicked out of my content with periodic app changes. I send multiple emails and have yet to get a response. I regret having ever spent money on this app and would advise against anyone else purchasing anything in it. The customer service is non-existent if you have any issues.

reviews.title: Highly disappointed
reviews.text: This app used to be free so why do I have to pay now to see more than a preview?! Never seeing me again!

reviews.title: Subscription?
reviews.text: I love this book, but why did it become a monthly subscription for those of us who already had purchased the app?   Seems a bit unfair to me.
I bought this app a long time ago. Now I can’t look at it anymore unless I subscribe? What the heck?

reviews.title: Unfortunate
reviews.text: I paid for this app several years ago (around $10) to OWN it - like I own the book. Now they want me to pay $36 annually for what I already paid for.  That’s unfortunate.

reviews.title: What happened to my book?
reviews.text: I purchased this years ago and now I opened it today and all but the first week of January is locked unless I pay for a monthly subscription! Why so greedy!?

reviews.title: Pathetic
reviews.text: Whoever is in charge of this app needs to make every day of the year completely free of charge to read. It’s pathetic that people have to pay for a subscription just to access the full devotional. This is supposed to be an app centered around sharing God’s Word and encouraging people in their faith, yet so much of the content is locked behind a paywall. At the very least, every daily devotional should be freely accessible without requiring a subscription. Faith shouldn’t feel like a subscription service. Do better!

reviews.title: Access denied after years of access
reviews.text:
The Jesus calling app reflects a company who has become greedy and is forgetting why the book was originally written. Years ago, I paid a higher amount to gain full access to the app. Now I am asked to pay a monthly fee for that same access. Unacceptable, Harper Collins and Sarah Young!  My recommendation is to go buy the book and 
Skip this app!

reviews.title: Don’t buy this app
reviews.text: Even when you pay them you own nothing and they can’t be bothered to help you get their app working

reviews.title: Paid Subscription not working
reviews.text: I have had Jesus calling for a long time. It has had program problems before but usually gets fixed in a reasonable amount of time. This time it’s been 2 months and I can’t get it to work correctly. They keep saying they are working on it. Love the program when it’s working correctly.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: It's a wonderful book that I bought years ago. I just thought it would be nice to have it on my phone as well but a monthly subscription is crazy

reviews.title: Fraud
reviews.text: I initially paid for a book and read it until the app came out and have used the app for years and now you have gotten gteedy now that she has passed away and locked me out. Is that a Christian thing to do. I will not pay for it anymore So disappointing

reviews.title: The App is not Supported
reviews.text: I have “Jesus Calling” and “Jesus Today” in book form, and love them. I purchased “Jesus Calling” on my phone so I would have the devotions with me when I travel. This worked great for years until the app makers decided to make “Jesus Calling” a monthly subscription. If you had already purchased “Jesus Calling,” it was still supposed to work. When they make updates it sometimes locks early supporters out of the content. I look at this as I purchased a book, and now they want me to repurchase it every month. Support helped me at first when I was locked out, but now they don’t respond. This would be disappointing from any company, but to have a Christian devotional behave this way is really sad.

reviews.title: Confused
reviews.text: When I listen to the audio for the day, sometimes not all of the Bible verses are read. Is there qualify control there?

Why does this app charge a monthly subscription now? I already paid for the book & a one time app fee many years ago.

Now I can’t access what I paid for. Greed over Jesus. So sad.

reviews.title: Greet product.  Poor company.
reviews.text: I purchased the app when Sarah Young was still alive. Everything worked fall asleep and there was full access to everything. After her passing all of a sudden, every time I open the app it's asking me to resubscribe and functionality of the app was limited. It's a horrible business practice. As much of a positive as the book and app have been in my life, it upsets me that whoever took over the company is doing what they are doing.

reviews.title: I no longer have Legacy access to Jesus Listens with audio, Jesus Always and Jesus Today
reviews.text:
6 months ago due to system issues at Harper I lost Legacy access to Jesus Listens with audio, Jesus Always and Jesus Today. I am only able to access Jesus Calling.

I sent an E Mail to the Harper team who sent me  instruction on how to restore access, I followed the instructions but it did not restore access.

I contacted them again by E Mail and received a response that  it was a problem on their end and it asked that I be patient.

So I waited a month, still no access. I have contacted them numerous times but have not received any response.

I have purchased over 350 Jesus Calling Devotionals over the years to give to friends,  family and to people who are receiving treatments for cancer at the hospital where I have been receiving treatments. 

Based on what it’s mostly Legacy accounts that have lost access . It doesn’t say much for the integrity of Harper.

reviews.title: I bought this app and now I have to subscribe to it?
reviews.text: I hate to rate one of my favorite apps as a 1, but I’m upset that I purchased this app several years ago and now when I want to start re-reading it this year I have to subscribe to it? I always hoped they would expand it so that I could purchase Sarah’s other devotional inside the app, but I don’t want to commit to an ongoing subscription. This ruins it for me and now I can’t do my devotional.

reviews.title: Was my GO TO for 15 years….😔
reviews.text: It used to this everyday for years. And when I became disabled in a fixed income I could no longer afford it.

reviews.title: Great when it works, but often kicks me out
reviews.text: For some reason, every few weeks, the system kicks me out and forgets my purchase and all my saved bookmarks. It takes forever to figure out how to log back in, but my bookmarks are gone. Why does this keep making me start all over? I’ve already paid my dues on multiple different platforms.

reviews.title: Charging me again for the app I already purchased
reviews.text:
I purchased the app previously. Now it is locked and won’t let me use it without paying again. Ups like the lock lifted. At a minimum they should refund my original
Purchase.

reviews.title: Used it for years before they went big biz
reviews.text: I paid $9.99 for this app how many years ago. And now I am not allowed to use it unless I subscribe. That is not OK.
